text:
Alex Carter: Quick sync request — Polaris partner wants a focused perf/W sprint next week. Goal: get a validated throughput vs watt curve and a kernel-tuning checklist we can hand off to them. Who can own the telemetry spec and the CI runs?

Priya Singh: I can own telemetry/schema. Need to confirm the power probe mapping (PMIC pins) from partner. Also we should standardize on 3 workloads: gen-chat (redwood-3b, seq=2048), embeddings-mlp, and a perf-only seq512 benchmark.

Ismail Khan: I can drive kernel tuning. Do we have permission to push a nightly DK patch to their dev images? If not, we'll provide a patch + steps. Also need to know if they'll accept AVX512->FP16 mixed runs or if we must stay strictly quantized.

Kate Moran: I'll coordinate partner comms and SIs. Proposed deliverables: 1) telemetry schema + sample CSV; 2) runbook (commands + env); 3) tuning checklist w/ knobs and safe defaults; 4) acceptance matrix for marketplace listing. ETA: end of week for drafts?

bench-bot: Scheduled bench window created: polaris-watt-sprint · start=2026-04-07T09:00Z · duration=48h · runners=4 · owner=@Alex Carter :zap:

Alex Carter: Thanks. Priya — can you post the telemetry schema here? Prefer minimal fields: run_id, model, seq_len, batch, tokens_generated, avg_power_w, peak_power_w, avg_latency_ms, stable_throughput_tok_s, kernel_version, notes.

Priya Singh: Yep, draft below — please comment.

```csv
run_id,model,seq_len,batch,tokens_generated,avg_power_w,peak_power_w,avg_latency_ms,throughput_tok_s,kernel_version,note
12345,redwood-3b,2048,1,10000,465.2,521.8,12.3,812.1,5.13-rt,initial
```

Ismail Khan: Tuning checklist (short): 1) set CPU governor to performance; 2) disable c-states for bench hosts; 3) enable hw_pstate if supported; 4) apply our Polaris kernel patch (link + sha) with reduced prefetch and tuned IRQ affinity; 5) verify pcie-link-state; 6) run 3 dry runs to stabilize KV cache. I'll add exact sysctl keys in the runbook.

Alex Carter: Good. Add a non-regression test: must not lose >3% throughput on seq512 baseline after kernel changes, and perf/W improvement target >= 7% for gen-chat at seq2048 to mark as "win".

Priya Singh: Repro command for CI (docker):

```bash
docker run --rm --gpus all redwood/bench:latest \
  --model redwood-3b \
  --seq 2048 \
  --batch 1 \
  --profile power \
  --output /artifacts/$RUN_ID.csv
```

Kate Moran: I'll schedule a short kickoff with Polaris and the SI leads tomorrow 10am PT. Agenda: scope, data sharing (NDA bits), image push cadence, and marketplace acceptance criteria. Invite includes Ismail + Priya + their HW-eng lead.

Ismail Khan: One ask to partner: expose per-socket power counters and raw PMIC logs. If they can't, we fallback to clamp-based wall wattmeters but note reduced fidelity.

Priya Singh: Also: include a sample prometheus exporter config to scrape host power metrics and GPU telemetry. I'll attach that to the runbook.

Alex Carter: Perfect. Can everyone drop a 1-sentence risk callout before EOD? I'll collate and send to Polaris.

Kate Moran: Risk: NDA delays on images -> fallback: provide VM recipe + patch steps.

Ismail Khan: Risk: kernel patch causes stall on older boot ROMs; mitigations: staged canary and quick rollback script.

Priya Singh: Risk: power sensor mismatch across sites -> mitigation: normalise to per-run idle baseline and record calibration run.

bench-bot: Reminder scheduled: polaris-watt-sprint preflight checklist due in 6h.

Alex Carter: Great, thanks team. I'll draft the kickoff note and include timeline: draft artifacts by Thu EOD, partner call Fri 10am PT, bench window Tue-Wed next week. :handshake:
